title: Web Page Reader — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Extracts readable content from accessible web pages. The Web Page Reader fetches a web page and extracts its readable content: headline, body text, and key metadata, stripped of navigation, ads, and boilerplate. It handles standard HTML pages and reports the extraction method used, so downstream tools know how much to trust the text.
capabilities: Fetch and clean article body text
Extract title, author, publish date when present
